title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node runtime workflows, upgrade to node20, and centralize caching
author: Samir Rao
description: This PR consolidates multiple duplicate GitHub Actions workflows across the monorepo, upgrades the Node runner and setup to node20, centralizes the caching/composite action used by build/test/lint jobs, and cleans up legacy job matrix cruft. Motivation: reduce CI maintenance burden, speed up cold-cache runs by standardizing cache keys, and unblock flaky infra caused by inconsistent Node versions across repos. Changes touch workflow YAMLs under .github/workflows and a new .github/actions/setup-node-cache composite action. Also includes small docs update to CI.md and changes to the release workflow to rely on a single trusted job. See commits for details.
commits: feat(ci): add composite action .github/actions/setup-node-cache for node setup + cache
refactor(ci): replace repo-level build/test workflows with consolidated matrix workflow
chore(ci): upgrade actions/setup-node and node-version to 20 across workflows
fix(ci): tighten cache key to include lockfile checksum to avoid stale artifact restores
docs: update docs/CI.md with new workflow names and troubleshooting notes
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows, upgraded Node to v20 for GitHub Actions, added a shared composite action for node setup and caching, tightened cache keys to include lockfile checksum. No functional code changes.
